name: Southwest Rapid Rewards® Plus Credit Card

localized_names.en: Southwest Rapid Rewards® Plus Credit Card

apr.notes: Variable APRs; see current Chase pricing and terms for exact rates.

rewards.redemption_notes: Rapid Rewards points are transferred to Southwest Airlines after each billing cycle.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 50,000 bonus points after spending $1,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: First checked bag free
benefits.description: Primary Cardmember and up to eight passengers traveling on the same reservation can each receive their first standard checked bag free on eligible Southwest-operated flights. Save up to $90 round trip ($45 per bag per trip).

benefits.title: Standard seat selection within 48 hours
benefits.description: Primary Cardmembers may select a Standard seat within 48 hours prior to departure, when available, for themselves and up to eight additional passengers on the same reservation.

benefits.title: 3,000 anniversary points
benefits.description: Receive 3,000 bonus points each account anniversary year.

benefits.title: 10% annual flight discount
benefits.description: Receive a 10% promo code each year on your Cardmember anniversary (Excludes Basic fare).

benefits.title: 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points boost
benefits.description: Earn one 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points boost each year.

benefits.title: Group 5 boarding benefit
benefits.description: Cardmembers and up to 8 additional passengers in the same reservation will board with Group 5 giving them earlier access to overhead bins.

benefits.title: 25% back on inflight purchases
benefits.description: Receive 25% back as a statement credit on eligible Southwest Airlines inflight purchases.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.

benefits.title: Complimentary DashPass
benefits.description: 12 months of complimentary DashPass for DoorDash and Caviar when first activated with the card between 02/01/2025 and 12/31/2027; auto-renews at the then-current monthly rate after the complimentary period.

benefits.title: DoorDash non-restaurant order discount
benefits.description: After activating DashPass, receive a $10 discount each calendar quarter on one qualifying non-restaurant DoorDash order while enrolled in DashPass.

benefits.title: Complimentary Instacart+ membership
benefits.description: 3 months of complimentary Instacart+ membership when activated with the card for the first time between 5/1/2025 and 12/31/2027; auto-renews at the then-current annual rate after the complimentary period.

benefits.title: Monthly Instacart credit
benefits.description: One $10 Instacart credit each month you have an active Instacart+ membership, after activating the complimentary membership, from 5/1/2025 through 12/31/2027.

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: First standard checked bag free for the primary Cardmember and up to eight passengers on the same reservation on eligible Southwest-operated flights. Save up to $90 round trip ($45 per bag per trip).
